name: Windscribe
author: ariadev
description: Windscribe VPN state in the Omarchy bar: connection status at a glance, plus a panel to connect, disconnect, toggle the firewall, and pick from every available location.

barWidget.description: One bar icon reflecting Windscribe's connection state, and one panel: current location, protocol, tunnel IP, live throughput and data usage, connect/disconnect, firewall toggle, and a searchable list of favourite, static and regional locations.

schema.label: Status poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to run `windscribe-cli status` while idle. Transitions always poll every 2 seconds regardless.

schema.label: Show location next to the icon
schema.description: Draw the connected city in the bar alongside the icon.

schema.label: Hide the icon when disconnected
schema.description: Collapse the bar slot entirely unless Windscribe is connected or connecting.

schema.label: Look up public IP
schema.description: Fetch the egress IP from an external service once per connection change. Off by default: it is the only thing this widget does that leaves your machine.
